label: ACCEPT
reason: Every @Component class sampled (AppComponent, DocumentDetailComponent, DocumentAttributesComponent) carries the Component suffix, a team naming scheme; src-ui/eslint.config.js lists the angular-eslint recommended rules by hand but does not enable @angular-eslint/component-class-suffix (nor turn it off), so nothing catches a violation. clear: false and hesitated with WRONG mixed_group because the wording 'classes in *.component files' also covers the exempted helper models (FilterableDropdownSelectionModel, PermissionsSelectionModel, CustomFieldQueriesModel) and base classes (ComponentWithPermissions, LoadingComponentWithPermissions), which legitimately lack the suffix.
